Definition: from G2993; a Laodicean, i.e. inhabitant of Laodicia:--Laodicean.
BiblicalUsage: The Laodiceans are the church at Laodicea, and the word appears once, in the closing of Colossians in Colossians 4:16: when the epistle is read among the Colossians, "cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans."
TheologicalSignificance: What convinces me is that the one verse shows how the churches shared the word: Paul's letter was not for one church only, and the Laodiceans were to hear what Colosse heard.
